notablePrerequisites: You control a land that can tap to produce at least {C}.
easyPrerequisites: Market Festival attached a mana-producing land you control.
description:
Activate a land and the land with Market Festival attached if it isn't the same land by tapping it, adding at least {C}.
Market Festival triggers, adding {2}.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Cloud of Faeries.
When Cloud of Faeries enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping the land(s) tapped in step 1.
Repeat.
